name: dsh-archived-purge
description: Archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: automatic, reversible cleanup. Idle archived Sessions move into a quarantine (log, projection cache, produced files) after a grace window, stay restorable for a retention period, then are removed for good. Status, restore and one-off runs are reachable from chat tools as well as the settings page.
author: 5D-artist

scripts.test: node --test test/host.test.mjs test/http.test.mjs test/clean.test.mjs test/leftovers.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/quarantine.test.mjs test/auto.test.mjs test/auto-http.test.mjs
